{"metadata":{"description":"导入本地 Claude、Codex、Grok、Gemini、Copilot、OpenCode 与 CC Switch 配置。 为支持的官方供应商提供 OAuth 登录。 从 OpenAI 兼容网关的 /v1/models 与 /models 发现 CC Switch 模型。","id":"gh:1335828671","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-auth-everying","slug":"chenbin-dev/dsh-auth-everying","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"导入本地 Claude、Codex、Grok、Gemini、Copilot、OpenCode 与 CC Switch 配置。 为支持的官方供应商提供 OAuth 登录。 从 OpenAI 兼容网关的 "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"/v1/models 与 /models 发现 CC Switch 模型。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-auth-everying"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"`dsh-auth-everying` is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for importing local coding-platform login state and"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" provider configuration. It lets you choose which imported models appear in the DSH model picker."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- Imports local Claude, Codex, Grok, Gemini, Copilot, OpenCode, and CC Switch configuration.
- Suppo"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"rts OAuth login for compatible official providers.
- Discovers models from OpenAI-compatible CC Swit"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ch gateways through `/v1/models` or `/models`.
- Exposes the Codex app-compatible `low`, `medium`, `"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"high`, `xhigh`, and `max` levels without changing their wire values. The unsupported `minimal` level"},{"id":"p5s5","text":" is hidden for CC Switch Codex routes.
- Uses `medium` as the concrete Codex default so DSH does not"},{"id":"p5s6","text":" add its separate `Default` provider-default option.
- Adds `ultra` only to models that declare or a"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"re known to support it. Non-reasoning and unsupported models do not show that selector.
- Preserves "},{"id":"p5s8","text":"the configured Codex `model_reasoning_effort` and sends `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`, and"},{"id":"p5s9","text":" `ultra` with the same wire value.
- Supports Windows installation and build workflows."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- A working DeepSeek Harness installation with the `dsh` command available in PowerShell or a termin"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"al.
- A web profile, because the settings panel is provided by the DSH web interface.
- Node.js 22.1"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"9 or later only when building the project from source."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"After the package is published to npm, the shortest installation command is:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Until the first npm release is published, install directly from the public GitHub repository:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Run these commands in PowerShell or a terminal:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The package name and the GitHub repository are different distribution channels. Publishing the repos"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"itory does not by itself publish the npm package."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"If DSH is already running, restart `dsh web` after installing or updating the plugin so the new bund"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"eady running, restart `dsh web` after installing or updating the plugin so the new bundle is loaded."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## First-Time Setup"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"1. Open the DSH web interface and go to **Settings > dsh-auth-everying**.
2. In **Sources**, select "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"the local login or provider configuration to import.
3. Click the import action and wait for the sca"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"n to finish.
4. In **Imported**, enable the models that should be available in DSH.
5. Start a new c"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"onversation or refresh the model picker."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The plugin reads local configuration from common locations, including CC Switch, Codex, Claude, Grok"},{"id":"p18s2","text":", Gemini, and OpenCode. It does not require copying API keys into the project or into the README."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## CLI"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Show available sources and imported routes:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Import sources by ID after checking `status`:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Use the source IDs reported by `status` when your local installation exposes different IDs."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Troubleshooting"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### The plugin does not appear in Settings"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Confirm that the install command completed successfully, stop the existing `dsh web` process, and st"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"art it again. Also verify that the command uses the `web` profile."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### The imported route has no models"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Open the plugin settings and run the source scan again. For a CC Switch OpenAI-compatible provider, "},{"id":"p29s2","text":"confirm that its gateway is reachable and supports either `/v1/models` or `/models`. The configured "},{"id":"p29s3","text":"default model is retained when the gateway does not provide a model list."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"### The reasoning levels do not match the provider"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"For CC Switch Codex routes, the selector matches the Codex app: `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, an"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"d `max` are available, while `minimal` is hidden. The plugin uses `medium` as the concrete default, "},{"id":"p31s3","text":"so DSH does not add its separate `Default` entry. `ultra` is model-specific: the plugin reads option"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"al reasoning capability metadata from the gateway and otherwise enables it only for the known GPT-5."},{"id":"p31s5","text":"6 Codex aliases. Models without that capability, such as image or automatic-review models, do not sh"},{"id":"p31s6","text":"ow `ultra`. Each selected level is sent with the same wire value."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"### Windows installation or startup fails"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"Use Node.js 22.19 or later for source builds, restart DSH after installation, and ensure the `dsh` c"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"ommand is available in the same terminal where the plugin command is run."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"`npm run check` runs TypeScript checks, tests, and the production build."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"Do not commit authentication files, local databases, API keys, tokens, certificates, or `.env` files"},{"id":"p37s2","text":".
